title: SEC-2 Witness Quorum
description: A k-of-N witness quorum signature block attached to a ProofArtifact — the immune system's promotion rule (a claim is promotable only when a threshold of independent witnesses have signed it). FIPS posture: the signing primitive is ECDSA over NIST P-256 with SHA-256 (FIPS 186-4 / 140-3 approvable). FROST/Schnorr over ed25519 is NOT FIPS-approved and is deliberately NOT used here; see docs/SEC-2-witness-quorum.md. Strict (additionalProperties:false) so unknown fields fail closed.

scheme.description: Threshold scheme. Independent per-witness FIPS ECDSA signatures verified against a k-of-N policy (a true multisig quorum, NOT an aggregated threshold signature).

committed.description: What the witnesses signed: the identity of the ProofArtifact being witnessed. Binds the quorum to a specific ledger entry.

signed_payload_hash.description: sha256 of canonical(committed) — the exact bytes each witness signed.

roster.description: The enrolled witness set (public keys). len(roster) must equal threshold.n; witness_id values must be unique.

public_key_spki_b64.description: Base64 of the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (X.509) of the witness's P-256 public key.

signatures.description: Collected witness signatures. Verification counts DISTINCT valid witness_ids against threshold.k (fail-closed: fewer than k, or any signature from a witness not on the roster, or a tampered payload, denies promotion).

sig_b64.description: Base64 of the DER-encoded ECDSA signature over signed_payload (canonical(committed)).

fips_posture.description: Human-readable FIPS statement, mirroring how the spine made BLAKE3 advisory.
